title: Acquire a low-rank quadratic completion despite unknown diagonal and sparse corruption

scientific_scope_status: For raw alternating B=off(D)+S over F2 with unknown symmetric rank(D)<=r and at most M unordered sparse edges, acquire a retained exact completion after O(sqrt(rM)+r) coordinate deletions. Acquisition is unconditional and subexponential for r=o(n),rM=o(n^2). With the local-phase theorem, log(2+(m+M)/n)=o(log n) gives original-input subexponential exact counting.
